> I have always wanted to make a tank, so here it is. It has 2 movement tracks, a turret with an automated disk shooter, and a live camera view and tilt/panning sliders on a hosted webpage. This uses parts I already have, so no need for funding or a BOM.

## Build

### 2026-10-01 – All the digital work in one go, summarized over

**16h**

All the digital work in one go, summarized over

 3 days.

Wrote code while 3d model for the base was printing. Completed both the Mega and ESP32-Cam code and fixed some UART pin and sync problems. Had to spend quite some time researching different
 ESP32 pins, as my model had the unusual OV3660.

Assembled and added an unplanned extra capacitor after the system kept shutting down when quickly accelerating. Added a "recenter servos" button to the homepage. Also attached the battery to the frame so testing doesn't require having a dragging part lying around. More firmly attached the turret.

### 2026-10-01 – Testing

**2h**

Testing
I spent nearly 2 hours driving this thing around and changing servo variables occasionally, and after all that fun, I finally had to conclude that it had worked and go to bed. This project has been a nice break from school on a sick day, and I am glad I spent the time to work on it.
